source_quotes.n_subjects: In this study, the TUS group ultimately comprised a total of 24 individuals who had been diagnosed with depression
source_quotes.n_subjects.alt: The sham stimulation group comprised 12 depressed patients, with ages ranging from 18 to 54 years
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: all participants received 10 sessions of authentic ultrasound treatment following a 3-day washout period after completing 10 sham stimulation sessions
source_quotes.randomised: Stratified randomization guaranteed the matching of participants between conditions based on age, sex, education, and depression severity.
source_quotes.blinding: A single-blind, randomized, sham-controlled clinical study was conducted involving 24 patients with depression in the TUS group and 12 in the sham group.
source_quotes.sham_type: The experimental procedure and ultrasound parameter settings for the sham stimulation group mirrored those of the treatment group, with the sole exception being that the system did not emit energy following the initiation of ultrasound emission.
source_quotes.auditory_control: technically modifying the transducer assembly to standardize vibroacoustic characteristics between active and sham conditions, a formal, quantitative assessment of blinding integrity was not conducted
source_quotes.readouts: The assessments, including Hamilton Rating Scale for Depression score (HAM-D 24 item), Hamilton Anxiety Rating Scale (HAM-A 14 item), and Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), were performed by a qualified individual who was blinded to the patient's assigned treatment group.
source_quotes.adverse_events: Out of the 24 participants in the treatment group, three reported treatment-related adverse effects.

flags.reason: Paper never states a combined total of subjects exposed to real ultrasound (TUS group 24 + sham group 12 who crossed over to real TUS); group sizes listed instead.

Paper gives 1.45 MPa peak-to-peak in one sentence and 0.73 MPa 'free-field peak negative pressure' in another for what appears to be the same measurement; the peak-negative value (0.73 MPa / 730 kPa) explicitly labelled 'free-field' was used here.

Paper describes only a general procedural effort ('technically modifying the transducer assembly to standardize vibroacoustic characteristics') that does not match a specific auditory-control category; coded as other.
GreenValley BrainTech is not one of the named manufacturers in the vocabulary; coded as commercial_other.

readout_other: HAM-D 24-item; HAM-A 14-item; Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI)
direction_notes: TUS was intended to excite the hypoactive left dlPFC (BA46); after treatment, functional connectivity between BA46 and sgACC/vPCC decreased while connectivity with precuneus increased, and these connectivity changes correlated with HAM-D improvement.
safety_notes: Three of 24 TUS-group participants reported treatment-related adverse effects (headache in two, increased mental excitability in one); one of 12 sham-group participants reported a mild transient headache.

exposures.label: TUS to left dlPFC subregion BA46

target.label: Brodmann area 46 (BA46) of the left dlPFC

timing.protocol_description: The transducer was driven by an electronic control system to produce pulses with an operating frequency of 500 kHz, a pulse duration of 200us, a pulse repetition interval of 1 ms, and a pulse train duration of 100 ms. Each pulse train was delivered every 2 s for 20 min. Participants underwent 10 visits over a 12-day period, during which they received either active TUS or sham stimulation in the Brodmann area 46 (BA46) of the left dlPFC.
